purpose: 仅材质/配色/光照效果示意；不是实物照片或CAD工程图

images.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render / product-mockup.
Create ONE photorealistic studio product photograph from the supplied FreeCAD screenshot. This is a material-and-lighting visualization of an existing physical design, NOT a redesign.
Input image 1 is the authoritative geometry and camera composition. Preserve the exact silhouette, relative dimensions, chamfers, inset panels, visible split lines, screw positions, and all visible features. Compact desktop media computer: body 234mm wide, 212mm tall and 160mm deep, low 5mm black feet. Keep this compact depth and nearly square front.
Color/material: LIGHT COOL GRAY matte FDM-printed polymer outer side panels and folded chamfered top (#c9ced0), GRAPHITE BLACK matte printed front bezel, separate lower control fascia, bottom plinth and side grille (#252a2e). Only two orange accents: the round main knob at lower front right and the small narrow horizontal badge at lower front left, warm safety orange #f55c1b. Fine believable polymer microtexture, restrained faint print layer lines, no exaggerated roughness. The blank screen is dark unlit glass with gentle restrained softbox reflections, not blue luminous paint.
Keep FOUR small silver screen-corner screw heads; THREE small dark circular buttons immediately to the LEFT of the orange knob; the small orange badge on the opposite left. Do NOT add controls or labels.
Keep the ONE slim black top CD slot on the forward flat top plane. Keep the recessed octagonal graphite grille on the RIGHT side with TWELVE shallow diagonal upward-to-the-rear slit openings and angular recessed gray surround. Preserve the broad forward sloping top shoulder and rear sloping shoulder, separate top cover seam, cut bottom corners and chamfered lower control panel.
Composition: same elevated front-right three-quarter viewpoint as the CAD reference, whole object, grounded on a neutral warm light-gray seamless studio surface. Large soft key light high left, subtle fill from right, natural contact shadow, physically plausible highlights, professionally photographed small desktop prototype, 80mm product lens, crisp throughout. Centered with 12-15% margins. Landscape 3:2.
No text, no logos, no UI, no disc, no cables, no accessories, no people, no extra lighting strips, no wood, no metallic shell, no retro television styling. Do not change object proportions, panel counts or hardware layout.
images.refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the photographic three-quarter hero image to edit. Input 2 is the matching RIGHT SIDE view showing the correct grille pattern for this SAME object. Change ONLY the diagonal slot pattern inside the hero's right-side graphite grille so it has EXACTLY 12 individual parallel slot openings, matching input 2. Use the same pitch, width and gentle slope from input 2, correctly foreshortened in input 1's three-quarter perspective. Do not add slots outside the grille. Keep its octagonal boundary and gray surrounding recess unchanged. Preserve ALL remaining pixels and the existing shape, unlit glass, gray FDM polymer, graphite front, orange knob and badge, 3 buttons, screws, top CD slot, chamfers, seams, camera, lighting, background and contact shadows. No labels or text. This is a counted-slot correction only, not a redesign.

The subject is a 234mm wide, 212mm high, 160mm deep desktop media computer on low 5mm BLACK FLAT FRONT AND REAR SUPPORT RAILS. Keep the CAD silhouette, proportions, chamfered top shoulders, panel seams, holes and controls in place. Only improve material, lighting, contact shadows, and photographic realism. No redesign.
Materials: matte LIGHT COOL GRAY FDM-printed polymer housing #c9ced0 with restrained fine printing texture and faint layers, graphite black #252a2e printed front bezel/control fascia/side grille/base, orange #f55c1b only on the front round knob and front small horizontal badge. Screen is unlit dark reflective glass. Standard small silver fasteners may look real. Plastic, not brushed aluminum; no wood.
Neutral warm light-gray seamless studio tabletop/background, same soft left key light and gentle right fill as appearance reference, grounded contact shadow. Whole product centered, comfortable equal margins, sharp product photography, long-lens near-orthographic projection. No text, logos, UI, extra controls, added ports, RGB illumination, cables, props, disc, hands, extra objects or dimensions printed on image. No round rubber feet: retain the low black flat support rails from the CAD.
VIEW: EXACT STRAIGHT-ON FRONT ELEVATION, zero yaw and zero pitch, front face parallel to image plane. Preserve the near-square overall front proportions in CAD. We must NOT see the top plane or side plane, so the top CD slot is not visible from this angle. Upper pale-gray sloping shoulder band, four silver screen-corner screws, rectangular dark glass active display in graphite frame. Below: separate graphite control fascia with beveled top/bottom, a tiny horizontal orange badge at viewer left, THREE small dark buttons at lower right, and ONE large orange knob farther right. Keep the front control fascia screw holes/fastener points near its left and right ends. Dark, neat narrow panel seams, no colored internal electronics visible through seams. Low black flat front rail at base. Do not curve, tilt or widen the front.
images.refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the edit target, the photographic front view. Input 2 is the authoritative CAD FRONT geometry. Make a precise proportion correction to the product in input 1 while retaining its existing colors, textures, lighting, shadow, backdrop, front-on camera, orange knob and badge, three buttons and screw positions. The photographed body is slightly too wide and its screen is too short vertically compared with CAD. Restore the exact proportions shown in input 2: the entire object width to total height including feet is 234:217 (1.078:1); the active rectangular black GLASS SCREEN width-to-height must be EXACTLY 4:3 (200:150), not a widescreen panel. Increase the screen's vertical extent and the body height appropriately, preserving reference CAD bezel widths, lower control-panel height relative to body, the pale gray top chamfer band and all layout. Use input 2's silhouette and screen opening as the geometric authority, input 1 only for photographic materials. Do not add top or side faces, text, UI or ports. Same light-gray matte FDM plastic, graphite panels, orange accents. Whole object on the same seamless surface with comfortable margins.
